criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Four frames are strong: frame 1's threaded bores against lit brass, frame 2's exactly countable plan, frame 4's tank sized right beside a data hall, and frame 9's reverse of the cover. Frame 6 is an object in a void. Frame 7's copper reads as a wooden ruler on a leather-grain field. Frame 8's sheet sits mid-grey with a seal laid on the paper. Frame 5's roofs read as buttons and repeat frame 2's grid. Frame 3's arris is soft.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One dark staged register with the key from the left. The plate opens and closes the deck, and the brass accent is held to its law. The tank on 4 becomes the unit on 5. Frames 6 to 8 leave the plate's world, and the planned skeleton alternation was never built.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and every source was fetched. Phrasings that run past their sources: frame 7's dek and the caption say 'from 25 MW' where c4 bounds 25 to under 75 MW and c5 adds Substantiated Load. The caption's 'It reaches a different set' implies no overlap, though c7's quote covers a facility addition not yet energized. 'Last year's survey' on frame 5 rests on c45's paraphrase. The caption drops c32's 'itself'. c14's and c6's quotes are shorter than their claim text. The $500 rests on the Tribune. Frame 5's 'One roof for each tank' shows fewer than 140 roofs in frame.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: A reader learns what happened, who acts and the dates. The deck says the ERCOT route reaches a different population. No Texas place is named, the October 12th deadline had passed with no frame saying so, and the only thing left to do is wait for a report.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe and frame 2 pays at once. The turn is declared at 6 and 7 clarifies it. Frames 4 and 5 are a gallons detour, and the close lands quietly.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and within the house rules. Attribution-heavy, with 'drawn to illustrate' closing most deks. No regional texture. The caption opener is the best line.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Carousel no. 29 on September 19th covered the same docket item, tx-2026-0171, and the same ERCOT notice, 36 days back. The technique repeats nos. 56 to 58, the plan grid echoes 56 and 58, and the brass accent echoes 57.

one_sentence_fix: Bound the request to the set the notice names, on frame 7's dek and in the caption: proposed data centers of 25 to under 75 MW a utility has classified as Substantiated Load, plus Batch Zero facilities or facility additions not yet energized, and stop stating the two sets as disjoint.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Candlestick bushings on a featureless cabinet floating in black, with no pad, ground, fins or conductors.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower and pull back the camera so a concrete pad, crushed rock and contact fill the lower third, with radiator fin banks and shedded porcelain bushings.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The bus bar reads as a wooden ruler on a leather-grain field, and the standoffs barely show.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A metal response so the key throws one specular streak along the top face, smooth painted steel for the channel, and standoffs whose casts read under the bar.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The sheet sits in the grey middle and the seal reads as a ring laid on the paper. The cast is 0.109 against the dossier's 0.12.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Emboss the seal into the sheet and tighten the pool so the sheet's edges fall to near black.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The roofs read as buttons, the frame repeats frame 2's grid, and the crop hides roofs while the dek says one roof for each of 140 tanks.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Scale the field to fit all 14 by 10 roofs inside the frame below the dek, each with a visible shell and a long cast.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The band's arris is soft and the dek scrim's edge shows.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Sharpen the bevel so the key draws one crisp line across 70 percent of the width, and remove the scrim.
